title: Sable.Harbor.S01E13.2026.1080p.WEB-DL.H264-TESTGRP
description: RAR5 store-method set with `-hp` header and data encryption and PAR2 recovery heavy enough to rebuild a whole volume. Every article of an interior volume is deleted after posting, so the NZB lists a volume every server answers 430 for. The recovery set already covers the missing volume, so the health probe stays off — sampling a hole the set can fill adds nothing — and PAR2 creates the volume from nothing while the set keeps routing direct.
